item.title: Ford Philippines Aims To Keep Hybrid SUV Leadership With New Territory Hybrid Platinum. Yours For P 1.655M
item.description: Ford Philippines aims to solidify its lead as the country’s best-selling hybrid SUV with the launch of the new Territory Hybrid Platinum. The new variant sits atop the Titanium X bringing with it an elevated sense of style, added safety, and first-in-class luxury features. Read More »

item.title: Heritage and the here and now
item.description: AMID THE cacophony of new brands coming into the country — all eager to carve a niche for themselves in our robust auto market — Toyota has been calmly, steadily doing its own thing for decades.

item.title: Double flex
item.description: BYD CARS PHILIPPINES again grew its portfolio of electrified offerings with the recent unveiling of a duo of affordably priced options: the all-new BYD Atto 2 SUV and the new BYD Seal 5 DM-i sedan.

item.title: VinFast trains sights on moto dominance
item.description: VINFAST PHILIPPINES has officially expanded its portfolio beyond the four-wheeler market with the recent unveiling of three e-motorcycle models here.
